item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect lows from the mid-twenties to the low thirties with cloudy or mostly cloudy skies and rain and snow showers likely across the region. Tomorrow brings mostly cloudy or cloudy skies with a slight chance of lingering rain or snow showers early, and highs ranging from the low forties to the mid-forties. Precipitation will taper off overnight, with most areas seeing less than half an inch of new snow or less than a quarter of an inch of rain.
